blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Palace press officer Claire Castro on Monday said she will become bolder in defending the Marcos administration from fake news peddlers and destabilizers. She made the remarks following Presidential Communications Office Acting Secretary Lino Cayeteno’s support of her “combative style” in defending the administration and countering attacks against President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. READ: Claire Castro stays; she’s a ‘treasure in this gov’t’ – PCO Sec. Cayetano “Hanggat mayroon pong gumagawa ng mali, hangga’t may gumagawa ng fake news, hanggat may naninira sa gobyerno nang walang basehan, mas tatapang pa po tayo,” Castro said in an interview at Radyo Pilipinas Cagayan de Oro.
